description: This PHP source file defines the ScopeRepository class implementing scope management for OAuth2, including retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scopes, within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 repository namespace.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 scope repository for SuiteCRM, managing scope entities and scope finalization.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a ScopeEntity based on the provided scope identifier, returning null if not found.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes the list of scopes for a given OAuth2 grant type, client, and user, returning the scopes as-is.
